column1: # derivation: NULLIF(x, y) is built as CASE WHEN x = y THEN NULL ELSE x.
# §1.2: x = y is NULL when either side is NULL; §1.7: a NULL condition is not
# taken, so the ELSE (x) answers. nullif_xy over (x, y) = (1, 10), (NULL,
# 20), (3, NULL), (NULL, NULL), (5, 5): FALSE gives 1; NULL gives x = NULL;
# NULL gives x = 3; NULL gives NULL; TRUE gives NULL. nullif_x3 (y = 3): x =
# 1, NULL, 3, NULL, 5 gives 1, NULL (condition NULL, x NULL), NULL (TRUE),
# NULL, 5. Types: every branch INT64 (§8.19); nullable (§8).
